title: kithd: wire upload/download routes and BlobStore into AppState
description:
What: Wire the blob upload and download route handlers into kithd's axum router and add BlobStore to AppState.

Algorithm:
1. Add BlobStore field to AppState<W> struct in kithd/src/lib.rs.
2. In kithd/src/main.rs, create BlobStore::new(data_dir.join("blobs")) at startup (data_dir from CLI arg or env var KITH_DATA_DIR).
3. Pass BlobStore into AppState when constructing app.
4. In build_app, add routes:
   .route("/jmap/upload/:account_id", post(blob_upload_handler::<W>))
   .route("/jmap/download/:account_id/:blob_id/:name", get(blob_download_handler::<W>))
5. Apply same auth middleware (Caller extraction) to new routes as existing JMAP routes.
6. Run full cargo test --workspace to confirm no regressions.

Defensive rules: blob directory created at startup with proper permissions; no path outside data_dir used for blobs; AppState is Send+Sync+Clone compatible with BlobStore added.

Agent team: R reads AppState definition and build_app; I wires everything; T runs full cargo test --workspace; V verifies clippy clean and no regressions in existing test count.
